stem: A jeepney travels 24 km in 40 minutes. What is its average speed in kilometres per hour?
hints: Speed in km per hour needs the distance for a full hour (60 minutes), not 40 minutes.
Find the distance in 20 minutes first: 40 minutes is 2 lots of 20 minutes.
24 ÷ 2 gives the km in 20 minutes. One hour is 3 lots of 20 minutes, so multiply that distance by 3.

solution.methodName: Unit rate: divide to get the amount for 1

steps.action: Split 40 minutes into 2 lots of 20 minutes: 24 ÷ 2 = 12 km every 20 minutes.
steps.why: 20 minutes fits evenly into both 40 minutes and 60 minutes, so it is an easy stepping stone.

steps.action: One hour = 60 minutes = 3 lots of 20 minutes, because 60 ÷ 20 = 3.
The jeepney's average speed is 36 km/h.

trapNotes.60 km/h: This writes 40 minutes as 0.4 hour (24 ÷ 0.4). An hour has 60 minutes, so 40 minutes is 40/60 = 2/3 of an hour, not 0.4.
trapNotes.0.6 km/h: This is 24 ÷ 40, which is km per minute, not km per hour. Scale the time up to a full hour.
trapNotes.16 km/h: This multiplies by 2/3 (24 × 2/3) instead of dividing by it. In a full hour the jeepney goes farther than in 40 minutes.
